_about: Answer key for the bank-accounts spec. Checked against the lab API with curl before any model run (RWA commit 0729f68). 'planted' = the spec is wrong; 'correct' = the spec matches the server.

planted.claim: GET /bankAccounts/{id} answers 404 for an unknown id

planted.server: 200 with {} and the account is only marked isDeleted: true (still readable by id)

correct.claim: POST with a missing field answers 422 with errors per field
GET /bankAccounts/{id} with a malformed id answers 422

extra_true_findings: accountNumber as a number (not a string) answers 422
the error message is the generic "Invalid value" for every field
POST /login answers with the user object, including a password hash (the driver hides it)
